from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalance(BaseModel):
    """One company's cash balance from a single 10-Q filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    cash_line_item: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used for the cash line item (e.g. 'Cash', 'Cash and cash equivalents', 'Cash and short-term investments')")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric cash balance as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale the amount is expressed in: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The date the cash balance is as of")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of report (e.g. 'Form 10-Q')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt from the document showing the cash balance")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balances: list[CashBalance]
